text_blocks.snippet: A nasal swab is a common method used to collect a sample for COVID-19 testing. The procedure involves inserting a swab into the nostril, gently rotating it, and then removing it. This sample is then tested to detect the presence of the virus. Nasal swabs are used for diagnosing various respiratory infections, including COVID-19, the flu, and RSV.
